questions.text: What is the drawback of procedural programming and advantage of object-oriented programming? Compare procedure-oriented programming and object-oriented programming with the basic concepts and features of OOP.

What is operator overloading? List down the rules of operator overloading. Write a program to overload binary operators (+, -, *) using member functions or friend functions to perform arithmetic on complex numbers with real and imaginary parts.

What are the different types of file modes used in C++? Write a program with a class to represent an employee or student having data members (name, id, age, salary). Write records to a file, read them, and search a specific record using employee id or roll_no as a key.
Explain friend function and with program code, show how a friend function can be used to make a bridge between two classes. What is a friend class and when can a class be made friend?

What do you mean by a constructor? Explain different types of constructors in C++ (default, parameterized, and copy constructor) with syntax and examples. Why must the argument of a copy constructor be passed by reference?
What is multipath inheritance (the diamond problem) in C++? Explain how ambiguity due to multipath inheritance is resolved using virtual base classes with a code example.

Why do you need a virtual destructor? Distinguish between early binding and late binding, and explain runtime polymorphism using virtual functions with an example of an Employee base class and derived Manager class.
What is an abstract class? Define pure virtual function with suitable syntax and example. Why cannot an abstract class be instantiated directly?

Why are templates in C++ referred to as a form of generic programming? Show with an example how we eliminate code redundancy using templates. Write a program to read n numbers of any data type and sort them in descending order using a function template.

Explain exception handling along with its handling constructs (try, catch, throw). Develop a C++ program that shows multiple exception handling scenarios (e.g., catching invalid negative input, division by zero, or testing validity before computing square root).

When do we use default arguments in functions? When can conflict occur when default arguments and function overloading are used together? Write a C++ program to illustrate the concept of default arguments.
When should you prefer the use of inline functions? Explain with example. Explain function overloading in object-oriented programming and how the compiler resolves overloaded functions.

Create a class 'Time' with data members hour, minute, and second. Write a constructor to initialize time objects and a member function that adds two Time objects passed as arguments and displays the aggregate result (applying 60 seconds = 1 minute, 60 minutes = 1 hour).

Explain different forms of inheritance with an example for each. Create a class Person with data members to identify a person and inherit it to create a class Student. Demonstrate function overriding and constructor invocation order in inheritance.
Explain different ways binary operator overloading is performed. Using a class to model a 3x3 matrix, overload the + and - operators to add and subtract two matrices.
How is random access of data in files handled in C++? Explain the functions seekg(), seekp(), tellg(), and tellp() with their file positioning offset constants (ios::beg, ios::cur, ios::end).
